clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity, Pure Hearts draw a succubus from the Twisting Nether. Carendin Halgar gives these ritual reagents to Forsaken warlocks, who use them to manifest the demon and attempt to defeat and bind her.

Carendin Halgar gives Pure Hearts to warlocks who summon a succubus in the Undercity's Magic Quarter. Set on the summoning circle, these untainted spiritual essences lure the demon across the Twisting Nether and into the mortal realm. Once she appears, the warlock must resist her enthralling mind-charms and strike her down. Defeating the succubus asserts mystical dominance and sends her back to the Twisting Nether. Carendin then teaches the warlock the spell to summon her at will.
